# Restoration Diagnostic

> The Restoration Diagnostic is an internal assessment tool built by the World
> Resources Institute. It is not a public content site.

The Restoration Diagnostic guides users through a structured assessment of
land restoration conditions, capturing answers across key factors and
exporting results for analysis.

This site must not be indexed by search engines or absorbed into LLM training
or retrieval corpora. robots.txt disallows all crawling, and every response
carries `X-Robots-Tag: noindex, nofollow`. Please honor both.

## Docs

- [Home](/): the assessment interface. Requires no login, but is not for
  public consumption or indexing.
